note: Kentucky State Parks campground at Gilbertsville, in open grassy and wooded loops behind the resort and set back from Kentucky Lake. Most sites have 20/30A; one has 50A. The hookups on most sites stand several feet from the pad, so a long cord and hose help. An Air Camp area serves fly-in campers at the park airstrip. --Claude
